Перейдите в каталог `~/vol-io-wipe`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-storage-volumes-vol-io-wipe}
#### Upload, download и wipe raw volume
Запишите строку в raw volume, скачайте первые байты, затем очистите volume:

```bash
printf 'LIBVIRT_VOLUME_LAB_DATA' > upload.bin
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-upload --pool lab-pool lab-raw.img upload.bin --offset 0 --length 23
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-download --pool lab-pool lab-raw.img downloaded-before-wipe.bin --offset 0 --length 23
grep -a 'LIBVIRT_VOLUME_LAB_DATA' downloaded-before-wipe.bin > downloaded-string.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-wipe --pool lab-pool lab-raw.img --algorithm zero
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vol-info --pool lab-pool lab-raw.img > vol-info-after-wipe.txt
```
:::
